Notice Type:  Sources Sought 
 Notice Number:  PRARNG-27-SS39258 
 Notice Title:  Sources Sought – Potential Sole-Source Construction-Phase (Title II / Type “C”) Architect-Engineer Services, Project No. 431850, Camp Santiago, Puerto Rico 
 PSC:  C219 — Architect and Engineering - General: Other 
 NAICS Code:  541330 — Engineering Services (Size Standard: $25.5 Million) 
 Publication Date:  20 November 2026 
 Response Date:  7 December 2026, 1600 AST 
 Contracting Office:  United States Property and Fiscal Office (USPFO) for Puerto Rico, Purchasing and Contracting Division, San Juan, PR 00904-9002 

  Synopsis:  

 This is not a solicitation nor a request for Architect-Engineer Qualifications using SF 330.  The Government will not issue an award resulting from this sources sought.  There are no solicitation documents. This notice is for market-research purposes only. The United States Property and Fiscal Office (USPFO) for Puerto Rico is conducting market research to identify responsible sources capable of providing Construction-Phase Architect-Engineer services (commonly referred to within the National Guard as Title II / Type “C” services) for Project No. 431850, Engineering Housing Maintenance Shop (EHMS), Camp Santiago Joint Training Center, Salinas, Puerto Rico. 

 The original Designer of Record, CH2M HILL–HDR JV (CAGE: 750V1), prepared and sealed the final design package (NGB Type A and Type B) under Task Order W912LR21F0002 and completed the Code and Criteria design recertification on 6 March 2026 under Contract W912LR25CA001. Construction Contract W912LR27CA001 was awarded on 16 October 2026. Notice to Proceed is anticipated on or about 8 December 2026, with initial technical submittals due on or about 7 January 2027 and physical construction mobilization scheduled for 30 January 2027. 

 This requirement is for professional A-E services governed by 40 U.S.C. § 1101 et seq. and RFO FAR 36.102 and 36.202. The period of performance will be 730 calendar days. The selected firm must commence initial technical-submittal review services within five (5) calendar days after issuance of the A-E Notice to Proceed and provide construction-phase support no later than 15 January 2027. 

 Required Construction-Phase (Title II / Type “C”) A-E services include registered professional engineering and architectural technical supervision, design-intent interpretations, technical evaluations and recommendations for Government approval on Requests for Information (RFIs), shop drawings, and technical submittals; on-site resident construction observation; inspection documentation and technical reporting in support of Government quality-assurance functions; review of material testing results; technical verification of red-line as-built record drawings; and design-conformance verification of building systems performance against the approved design baseline. 

 All contractual direction that changes contract scope, price, terms, or schedule remains the exclusive authority of the Government Contracting Officer. The Construction-Phase A-E contractor will provide technical evaluations and recommendations only and will not direct the construction contractor or approve deviations from contract requirements. 

 The Government is considering whether this requirement may qualify as a follow-on acquisition under 10 U.S.C. § 3204(a)(1) and § 3204(b), as implemented by RFO FAR 6.103-1, on the basis of potential substantial duplication of cost or unacceptable delay. Information received in response to this notice will be evaluated and considered in determining whether to conduct a competitive A-E acquisition or pursue a sole-source approach. 

  Key Considerations the Government Will Evaluate:  

 
	 The original firm’s continuing professional responsibility under its prior contracts and the requirements of Puerto Rico Law 173 of 1988 (20 L.P.R.A. §§ 711 et seq.) regarding technical control and sealing of professional work. 
	 The effort and cost that would be required for a new firm to validate the existing final design record (207 drawing sheets, 2,217 specification pages, geotechnical report, and March 2026 recertification) and establish clear responsibility boundaries. 
	 Whether any firm can meet the required start dates (submittal review within five days of A-E NTP and on-site support by 15 January 2027) without causing delay to the construction contract. 
 

  Response Instructions:  

 This notice is issued for market-research purposes in accordance with RFO DFARS PGI 206.103-170(d) (AFARS 5106.103-170(d)) and RFO FAR 5.101. The Government is not requesting competitive request for qualifications or SF 330 submissions at this time. 

 All responsible sources may submit a written Capability Statement (not to exceed 10 pages) no later than 7 December 2026, 1600 AST. Capability statements must include: 

 (1) Legal business name, address, Unique Entity Identifier (UEI), CAGE code, point of contact, and business size under NAICS 541330; 
(2) Demonstrated capability to provide appropriately licensed Puerto Rico professionals (20 L.P.R.A. §§ 711 et seq.), independently validate the existing final design (NGB Type A/B) and March 2026 recertification design record to the degree required for Construction-Phase (Title II / Type “C”) services, and review and seal any revised design documents for which the firm assumes professional responsibility; 
(3) A quantified estimate of the transition time and cost required to validate the existing design record, along with a staffing schedule demonstrating the ability to commence initial technical-submittal review services within five (5) calendar days after issuance of the A-E Notice to Proceed and provide on-site construction-phase support at Camp Santiago no later than 15 January 2027; and
